title: Lesson
description: A lesson of a module: a sequence that its author made — explanations, worked examples and tasks, in order — and the skills of the module that it teaches. The skill graph orders the lessons.

id.description: The lesson's local ID: the name of its file, without .yaml.

title.description: What the lesson is called, in the module's explanation language. The learner sees it before every task of the lesson, and the leak check searches it for their keys.

skills.description: The skills of the module, by local ID, that the lesson teaches. Every task of the lesson trains one of them as a primary skill.

age_categories.description: The age categories that the lesson suits, when they are fewer than the module's: the platform gives the lesson only to a learner whom the lesson and each of its tasks suit.

segments.description: The segments of the lesson, in the author's order: explanations, worked examples and tasks. No two are the same.

explanation.description: An explanation: paragraphs and pictures that the learner reads, in order, in the module's explanation language.

worked_example.description: A worked example: an example solved before the learner's eyes, on a handwriting sheet.

task.description: A task of the module, by its local ID. The next segment begins when the task ends.

segment.description: A segment of a lesson: an explanation, a worked example or a task, by its one field.

statement.description: What the example asks: paragraphs and pictures in order, as a task's statement.

kind.description: A worked example is shown on a handwriting sheet.

canvas.description: The sheet that the author's demo is shown on: a handwriting sheet and its grid. The learner does not write on it.

demo.description: The author's demo: the parts of how the example is solved, in order, which the learner opens one at a time and may hide.

worked_example.description: A worked example of a lesson: no task, with no answer slots and no key.

text.description: A paragraph of the demo, as plain text.

picture.description: A picture of the demo, by its path from media/.

alt.description: What the picture shows, in words: a screen reader reads it, and it stands in the picture's place until the picture comes. Empty for a picture that only decorates.

width.description: The width that a picture beside the sheet is shown at, in CSS px.

height.description: The height that a picture beside the sheet is shown at, in CSS px, in proportion to its width.

area.description: The area of the sheet that a picture on the sheet is shown in, at its size, on the canvas layer of the author's demo.

demo_part.description: A part of the author's demo: a paragraph; a picture beside the sheet, with what it shows and its size; or a picture on the sheet, with what it shows and its area.
